unit.why: A single anecdote: a merchant asks the Ropshitz tsaddik to bless his business trip, is instead blessed with his wife's recovery, and later learns she had fallen dangerously ill and recovered that same day.

stories.start_quote: סיפר לי בעה״ב כשר אחד תורני ויר"א
stories.end_quote: בלי מסך המבדיל בכל העולם כולו
stories.summary_en: A merchant passing through Ropshitz gives the tsaddik a kvittel asking for business success. The tsaddik twice answers only with a blessing for his wife's full recovery. The business fails, and at home the merchant learns that his wife had fallen dangerously ill and began to recover on the very day of his visit.
